description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'RecruitmentAttachmentDaoTest' for testing the 'RecruitmentAttachmentDao' data access object within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It includes setup, and multiple test cases for CRUD functionality related to recruitment attachments.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachmentDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for RecruitmentAttachmentDao, verifying functionality such as saving, retrieving, and deleting vacancy attachments.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, initializes DAO object, and populates test data using fixtures.

methods.name: testSaveVacancyAttachment
methods.description: Tests saving a VacancyAttachment and verifies the saved object's properties.

methods.name: testGetVacancyAttachmentContentById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a VacancyAttachment by ID and checks filename and type.

methods.name: testGetVacancyAttachmentsByVacancyId
methods.description: Tests retrieving all attachments for a specific vacancy ID and validates the list contents.

methods.name: testDeleteVacancyAttachments
methods.description: Tests deleting specified attachments and verifies deletion.
